# Plotly calendar runtime

Pinned official Plotly.js basic bundle 3.5.0 (bar, pie, scatter), matching the
Plotly.js version bundled with the portal's installed Plotly Python package.
Includes the upstream MIT license header. Bundled locally so the calendar
does not need a CDN connection in the browser.

Source: https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-basic-3.5.0.min.js
